items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 67:1
items.html: (To the question) What is one wall of Gevurot? There is the aspect of the wall of HGT, drawn from the backs of the GAR of Bina, and it is discerned as the wall of Hassadim, for it draws Hassadim like the aspect of the GAR of Bina. And there is the wall of NHY, drawn from the backs of the seven lower ones of Bina, and it is called the wall of Gevurot, which in the smallness are harsh Gevurot, and in the greatness are the rejoicing Gevurot. And the first wall without the second wall is discerned like HGT lacking NHY, where there is only the VAK of Hassadim, and then there is from the aspect of the Gevurot only the smallness, which are harsh Dinim.
